notes.title: 🎉 We are Coming to Steam!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45596917/7adb706dd76163cb1fa3766e5d6496cde9f2dff0.gif[/img]

[b]Guess Me If You Can[/b] is a fun multiplayer game where you explore a museum filled with curious and strange (but real!) items being sold on the internet, and try to guess their prices.

The game is still in development, and we’re working hard to make it as fun and ridiculous as possible.
🛒 [i]Wishlist it now and be the first to know when we launch![/i]

More updates soon!
